scripts.dev: bun scripts/generate-blog-translations.ts && bun scripts/sync-blog-markdown.ts && bun scripts/generate-blog-header-images.ts && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.build: bun scripts/ensure-blog-translations.ts && bun scripts/generate-blog-translations.ts && bun scripts/sync-blog-markdown.ts && bun scripts/generate-blog-header-images.ts && bun scripts/generate-hobby-optimized-images.ts && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && bun scripts/prune-static-export.ts && bun scripts/generate-rss.ts
scripts.test: bun run vitest:run && bun run e2e:run
scripts.vitest:run: bun scripts/generate-blog-translations.ts && bun run vitest:run:components && bun run vitest:run:core
scripts.e2e:dev: bun scripts/generate-blog-translations.ts && bun scripts/sync-blog-markdown.ts && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.e2e:install: bunx playwright install chromium firefox webkit
scripts.e2e:run: bunx playwright install chromium && bunx playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:open: bun run e2e:install && bunx playwright test --ui --headed --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:chromium: bun run e2e:install && bunx playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.e2e:firefox: bun run e2e:install && bunx playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.e2e:webkit: bun run e2e:install && bunx playwright test --project=webkit
